pricing.title: Model prices and synchronization
pricing.description: The model catalog is read directly from CLIProxyAPI /v1/models. CLIProxyAPI API Key and Management Key are used only for this operation. Prices are fixed at USD / 1M Tokens.
pricing.coverageWaiting: Price coverage: waiting for cost data
pricing.providerPriorityHelp: When the same model is priced by several providers on models.dev, providers listed first win and unlisted ones come last. Defaults to openai, google, anthropic when empty.
pricing.ignoredSuffixes: Ignored model suffixes (comma or newline separated)
pricing.ignoredSuffixesHelp: Stripped from the end of a model name before matching prices, e.g. glm-5.3-thinking is billed as glm-5.3. Common variants like -thinking, -preview, -high and -low are included by default; clearing the list restores those defaults.
pricing.mappingsHelp: Use this when CLIProxyAPI model names do not match the price book. One mapping per line as local-model=models.dev-model, e.g. gpt-5.6-sol-fast=gpt-5.6-sol. Mappings are applied before suffix stripping.
